findings_and_reconciliations.trace: Current quality score derives weighted category points independently, but assigns bare 0.0 whenever planned-frame or artifact completeness is false. Writer serializes the manifest and HTML summary before producing failed exit; HTML labels the zero as quality percent while also displaying acceptance failed. If a capture is incomplete while points are fewer than 31, the displayed 0% does not equal the complete-capture formula 100*(1−points/31). P17 instead uses Unavailable(IncompleteCapture), retains independent points and acceptance.
findings_and_reconciliations.conditions: Requires a completed-capture object with incomplete selected frames or missing/empty named artifact, successful manifest/HTML writes, and fewer than maximum defect points for the described discrepancy. Actual supported incomplete capture and category values have not been produced. Current 95e test source explicitly expects zero for incomplete capture, so conservative zero may be intentional; no false successful acceptance, viewer/browser, or runtime behavior is claimed.
findings_and_reconciliations.future_repair_direction: Decide whether the quality percentage represents a measured defect rubric or an intentional conservative incomplete penalty. If measurement is required, preserve unavailable reason through manifest and presentation while retaining explicit failed acceptance, weighted categories and intended incomplete-capture handling. No implementation in this audit.

thirteen_lens_perspectives.bounded_assessment: P17 Observation requires a real measurement for measured() and fails Unavailable for when_applicable; current raw scalar may encode a sentinel. Incomplete quality 0.0 is source-established but intended UI semantics are an owner question.

A quality percentage, defect categories and full acceptance are different observations. Capture completion and nonempty artifacts gate availability at P17 and force zero at 95e; each individual acceptance gate remains independently required.

P17 report Observation module is absent at both 6533 and 95e, while validation.rs is different from P17 and byte-identical across 6533/95e. Compare actual 90a and 95e source only; no chronological regression or product behavior claimed.

KneeHemisphereDot performs finite-only native admission, Observation encodes applicability and QualityPercent serializes a checked fraction as percent. No evidence supports deriving away those invariants or changing legitimate native output.
P17 NotApplicable, Unavailable(reason) and Measured preserve distinct evidence; independent quality category booleans are independent defects rather than necessarily one exclusive enum.

P17 UnitInterval and QualityPercent own normalized fraction and presentation conversion, HeightSample owns phase and signed height, while BoneRole and AnimationEventSpan own identity and wrapping sequences. Runtime numeric kernels remain native where appropriate.

P17 quality weights max at 31 and UnitInterval admits normalized fraction; KneeHemisphereDot rejects nonfinite values without overconstraining finite native rounding. Current explicit zero for incomplete is a policy representation, not numeric overflow evidence.

Thresholds, score weights 16/8/4/2/1 and 31 normalizer encode separate acceptance/rubric policies. P17/current display 31 agrees with maximum weight; chosen biomechanical bounds and alternate fixed64 playback remain independently open.

Typed scenario and BoneRole determine logic; semantic route path strings and static diagnostics are native output. Actual HTML label encoding and all programmatic producer grammar remain prior q1230, not a new unescaped-source claim.

Current capture height Option becomes zero into FrameSample and landing gate; report writer carries validation and percentage to JSON/HTML before failing exit. Prior authors and separate first failures remain intact.

Both acceptance result and exit derive from validation_passed, so quality fraction versus acceptance boolean are deliberately distinct policy quantities. Hardcoded score maximum and denominator align in observed bodies but remain separate expressions.

Measured zero, missing, and not applicable are distinct semantic states when a report requires measurement; nonempty file metadata, complete capture and semantic image quality are separate evidence levels.

Capture owns recording observations and current artifact provenance; report metrics own availability; validation owns applicability and predicates; HTML owns display. Central retains reconciliation, alias decisions and repair-ledger publication.
